question_text:
The table shows agricultural production volume (in metric tons) and value (in million pesos) for five crops across three regions:

| Crop | Region 1 Volume | Region 1 Value | Region 2 Volume | Region 2 Value | Region 3 Volume | Region 3 Value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rice | 500 | 12.5 | 600 | 15.0 | 450 | 11.25 |
| Corn | 300 | 6.0 | 350 | 7.0 | 280 | 5.6 |
| Banana | 200 | 4.0 | 250 | 5.0 | 180 | 3.6 |
| Coconut | 150 | 3.75 | 180 | 4.5 | 120 | 3.0 |
| Mango | 100 | 2.5 | 120 | 3.0 | 80 | 2.0 |

What is the total value (in million pesos) of all crops in Region 2?
